newsitem.title: USA: Rankin Automotive year profit narrows.
newsitem.headline: Rankin Automotive year profit narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Full company name is Rankin Automotive Group Inc.
The company said 1997 revenues rose 42.5 percent from a year ago, but it did not report 1996 dollar figure revenues.

The drop in 1997 earnings was caused by negative results in Q4, the company said. Much of the Q4 operational loss was the result of higher than anticipated costs associated with integrating the Mississippi store group into the Rankin organization, it said. Also, sales from the new group were 25 percent below expectations.
Same-store sales from stores in the Rankin group for at least one year rose 8.1 percent, it said.
